subject: flexible output function for ui.R (i.e., display a table or text depending on the input)

messages.author: 66aaf5d139ba9c7f
messages.subject: flexible output function for ui.R (i.e., display a table or text depending on the input)
parts:
I have the following in ui.R

tabPanel("Summary", verbatimTextOutput("summary")), 

In my app however, the output from summary may be a table as well. I looked at the verbatimTextOutput and tableOutput functions and it seem I should be able to do something like the function below. I am not clear, however, where to put it so (1) it has access to output$... and (2) ui.R can use it. Suggestions?

myOutputFunction <- function(outputId = "summary") {
  if(class(output[[outputId]]) == 'xtable') {
 pre(id = outputId, class = "shiny-text-output")
} else {
 div(id = outputId, class = "shiny-html-output")
  }
}

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: flexible output function for ui.R (i.e., display a table or text depending on the input)
parts:
If you want to dynamically decide what HTML is being generated, that is a sure sign that you need reactiveUI. The code in ui.R only runs once, at the start of your application (or when you edit ui.R and reload the page), then it is cached for all other requests.

So you could make a reactiveUI function that returns either verbatimTextOutput(outputId) or tableOutput(outputId); however, to choose between the two, you can't directly inspect output[[outputId]] since output is read-only (and it doesn't have this info for you anyway). Rather, you'd need to use a reactive function or reactive value.

Thanks Joe. I, again, had not idea you could do this with reactUI. Very nice. The following snippets seems to work.

Question: If I understand correctly there is (currently) no (easy) way to determine, in the example below, the type of output generated by output$tablereg and output$textreg from within flexsummary?

In ui.R you could have:

tabPanel("Summary", uiOutput("flexsummary")),

In server.R you could have:

output$flexsummary <- reactiveUI(function() {

if(input$tool == 'A') {
verbatimTextOutput("textreg")
} else if(input$tool == 'B') {
tableOutput("tablereg")
}
})

output$textreg <- reactivePrint(function() {
x <- rnorm(100)
y <- 34 + 6*x + rnorm(100)

summary(lm(y ~ x))
})

output$tablereg <- reactiveTable(function() {
x <- rnorm(100)
y <- 34 + 6*x + rnorm(100)

summary(lm(y ~ x))
})

messages.subject: Re: flexible output function for ui.R (i.e., display a table or text depending on the input)
parts:
How am I creating my tabs?

Here's some code clipped out of my logic: (not a working example)


output$graphBlock <- reactiveUI(function() {

  ...

  # Construct HTML for the tabs.  Note there's no body, since I use a common SVG for
  # all bodies.  You probably want a body.
  # plotSpec is a list of plots I want.  it's a named list of lists, each member has a 'name' 
  # property which is the title to print.
  panels <- Map(
        function(plotName)tagList(h4(plotSpec[[plotName]]$name),div()),
        reactiveVals$validPlots)

 # construct the tabs as an argument list
 paneltags <- lapply(names(panels),
                         function(plotName)tabPanel(plotName,panels[[plotName]]))
 paneltags$id <- "tabSelected" 

  # now build the tabs.
  Tabs=do.call(tabsetPanel,paneltags)
  return(Tabs)
